title: Akwaan Closest Slider Pilot Batch 01 — Football
sourceCatalog: local developer database (lammah-quiz) — NOT Production. Item ids are local ids.
whyThisBatchExists: Every Closest ContentItem in the catalog is legacy: it carries a prompt and a target and no mechanicPayload at all. The runtime renders the legacy number input whenever mechanicPayload.closestSlider is absent, so the shipped slider is unreachable until content authors a continuum. Nothing in the stored data determines what that continuum should be — choosing min/max, or two anchors, is a gameplay difficulty decision. This batch asks for exactly that decision and nothing else.
whyTheseScopes: No Scope in the catalog holds fifteen distinct legacy Closest items; the largest is twelve, and the only thirty-item Scopes are Puzzles fixtures repeating three prompts ten times each. Two Scopes is therefore the fewest that reaches twenty items, and both sit in one active World so the editorial context stays coherent. Every item in both Scopes is included, so no question was filtered by taste. Between them the targets already span single-digit title counts, tournament goal totals, season records, career totals in the hundreds, squad sizes, and two years nearly a century apart — which is the point: each needs a visibly different continuum.

assignPerItem: numeric-range: min, max, optional positive step, optional unit (<= 40 chars)
between-anchors: min, max, optional step, leftAnchor and rightAnchor (distinct, <= 80 chars)
mustPreserve: prompt — do not rewrite the question
correctValue — the factual answer is not negotiable
the factual meaning of the question
mustNotDo: rewrite the question unless separately approved
turn factual uncertainty into arbitrary bounds
hardValidationRules: min and max finite, min < max
correctValue must satisfy min <= correctValue <= max
if step is given it must be positive, and (correctValue - min) must be a whole number of steps
between-anchors requires two distinct non-empty anchor labels
no label or unit may give the answer away
the range must be playable on a phone: not so wide the target is unreachable, not so narrow it is obvious
contract.guidance: Prefer numeric-range for naturally quantitative questions — these twenty all are. Use between-anchors only where the question genuinely maps onto a continuum between two meaningful endpoints; note that the authored target must still sit inside the internal range, so anchors are rarely the right fit for a question that already has a numeric answer.

returnShape.rationale: one line on why these endpoints make the question a good guess

observations: Two prompts were noticed while exporting and are NOT to be fixed as part of this batch — reported so they can go through the normal content workflow: one World Cup prompt uses Arabic-Indic numerals and loose phrasing ('كم سجل ميسي هدف في كأس العالم ٢٠٢٢'), and one Premier League Scope item actually asks about a Europa League final.
doNotApply: This batch is a request for authoring only. Nothing here is written to any catalog until the authored result is reviewed.
